wants.topic: Son returning from the city to discover mistreated parents or abandoned wife, delivering immediate karma/justice
wants.evidence: AI Story Tool video 'शहर से लौटते ही बेटे ने माँ बाप को इस हालत मे देखकर लिया बड़ा फैशला' (vsNormal: 66.23, 5.7M views) and 'बारिश में गर्भवती बहु को घर से निकाला' (vsNormal: 13.74)

wants.topic: Cruel stepmother/in-laws marrying daughter to a seemingly poor man/beggar who turns out to be a secret billionaire or high official
wants.evidence: U P Story video 'सौतेली माँ ने भिखारी से करा दी शादी, पर वो निकला अरबपति का बेटा!' (vsNormal: 11.84, 2.7M views) and MESTAR STORY 'गरीब समझकर सबने किया अपमान... अर्जुन निकला असली DM' (vsNormal: 63.16)

wants.topic: Festival-themed family hardship and emotional resilience (e.g., Gareeb Ki Diwali)
wants.evidence: Toons Online video 'गरीब की दिवाली | एक गरीब परिवार की दिल छू लेने वाली कहानी' (vsNormal: 35540.65, 1.5M views)

wants.topic: Multi-part family drama sagas with heirloom/identity clues (lockets, twin secrets)
wants.evidence: U P Story video 'खोई हुई बेटी का लॉकेट और जुड़वाँ भाई का रहस्य (भाग 2)' maintaining strong retention across episodes

gaps: Realistic, Premchand-style grounded rural social dramas without reliance on exaggerated 'secret billionaire' tropes
Deeply layered stories focusing on the resilient abandoned wife taking independent moral/legal revenge rather than waiting for a heroic husband to return
Nuanced multi-generational family conflicts exploring modern urban vs traditional rural values beyond simple villainy
saturated: Generic 'Beggar husband is secretly a billionaire' (भिखारी बना पति निकला अरबों का वारिस) cloned across multiple small channels
Overused 'disrespected at airport/restaurant -> turns out to be SDM/Boss' (showing up in weakest videos like U P Story's waiter to SDM concept)
English-titled or fantasy/giant-creature shorts mixed into Hindi drama channels
title_patterns: [Cruel Action by Family] + [Unexpected Return/Event] + [Shock/Emotional Hook] (e.g., 'बारिश में गर्भवती बहु को घर से निकाला, तभी अचानक लौट आया बेटा... फिर जो हुआ! 😱💔')
[Underestimation/Disrespect] + [Secret Status Revealed] + [Emotional Drama Tag] (e.g., 'गरीब समझकर सबने किया अपमान 😢 अर्जुन निकला असली DM | दिल छू लेने वाली कहानी')
[Betrayal Premise] + [Identity Secret Twist] + [Part Indicator] (e.g., 'सौतेली माँ ने भिखारी से करा दी शादी, पर वो निकला अरबपति का बेटा!')
